findings.title: Implementer prose overstates the .rejections test priority placement
findings.detail: ZR403-IMPL-002 claims the .rejections location is at the highest priority ('.rejections 最高优先级位置'), but in test_c2_rejections_path_loses_to_healthy_lower_priority the .rejections root is dropbox_stock at priority 30 while company_raw p10 is highest. The pinned properties are nonetheless real and distinct: (a) health-beats-priority is pinned by test_c2_retired_high_priority_location_never_canonical (p10 retired vs p20 healthy -> dayu canonical, REUSED_EXACT, duplicate_count=2), exactly matching C2's 'higher-priority unhealthy + lower-priority healthy' wording; (b) the .rejections test pins that a .rejections location never becomes canonical even when forced active (UPDATE source_status='active' leak), with the healthy p10 copy winning. Prose-only overstatement; no acceptance criterion is unmet.
